text_block_list.text:
Some time had passed since Vodka began 
searching for what she should truly aim 
for.

Unlike Daiwa Scarlet, Vodka finds herself 
drawn to flashy, instant gratification 
rather than steady, diligent effort.

Vodka worries whether such a childish 
mindset will leave her unable to stand 
against powerful rivals.

The Trainer tells her that she should 
pursue "coolness" to the fullest, giving 
her a push forward.
